collection.name: BITCOPTERS
collection.description:
each bitcopter (aka bopcopter) is seeded by its inscription ID - but all 10,000 inscriptions have the same text content (/content/7deefa..) because it's a BRC-420, so to view your actual bitcopter with its true colors on-chain, get your specific inscription ID from the URL then go to the recursive submodule and enter your copters unique inscription ID: https://ord-mirror.magiceden.dev/content/7deefa35a2dee6d6d482c5384cfcbadb61e804800f968be0e60ac683a08f7e7ci0  

you can also directly link to it by adding the query param ?id=<inscriptionID> to the recursive submodule!
